en.bubbleDescription: On by default: final answers sit in a rounded bubble that separates them from the background, translucent in frosted-glass mode. Turn this off to lay answers flat on the page.
en.foldDescription: Default on: collapses earlier steps when new thoughts appear. Turn off to keep all thinking and tools expanded in full.
en.glassDescription: Off by default: reading chrome stays opaque, matching the current Host look. Turn this on to let wallpaper and skins show through the panel; path and count chips stay clear until hover or focus.
en.openDescription: Off by default: chips and inline file mentions open in the system app. Turn this on to preview them in the right Sidebar, matching official chat. Reveal and folder actions still use the system file manager.
en.pinDescription: Off: the collapsed thinking card stays at the top. On: it always scrolls to the newest line, including while streaming. Scrolling up or selecting text still pauses it.
en.railDescription: On by default: a canvas navigation rail at the conversation edge — fish-eye hover with summaries, click to jump, current-turn highlight. Off: no rail in the reading view; the conversation view returns to the official rail.
en.railRingDescription: On by default (matches the store default): a soft white sheen laid beneath the current and hovered marks, keeping them readable over busy wallpapers.
en.skillInstall: Copy the whole generative-mcpapps folder (including references and examples) into .dsh/skills or .agents/skills — in your home or the project, you choose — then Re-check. There is no one-click install that works on every host.
en.skillPluginNote: Shipping the pack inside this plugin repository does not install it into the harness skill catalog.
en.skillPurpose: This install is for model auto-selection of MCP Apps. Reader already renders mcp-app fences when the model emits them.
en.skillUnavailable: Could not query the host skill catalog. Copy into .dsh/skills or .agents/skills (home or project), then Re-check.
en.takeoverDescription: On by default: in the conversation view this rail replaces the official right-edge TurnNavigator (hidden, not unmounted). Turn off to hand the conversation view back to the official rail — this rail yields there. The reading view always uses this rail. At narrow widths the harness auto-hides the official rail; this switch restores it when off.
